result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled orders, so your example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1. The `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` class passes (4 tests, including a new one for this case).

Changes, all uncommitted:

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/PurchaseOrderStore.java`**, `countPerSalesRep`: the count subquery now adds the existing `NOT_CANCELLED` filter, as the other PO reports do. I also updated its Javadoc to say "non-cancelled". The comment in `listForCountry` said the per-rep count was cancelled-inclusive, so I changed it to refer only to the per-country count.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`, which reproduces the example. I also gave the test helper a status overload.

I didn't touch `countPerCountry`, which has the same gap: it still counts cancelled orders. The task only covered the per-rep report, so I left it alone. Say if you want it fixed too.
